name: assign_agent_role
description: Assign an IAM role to an agent's delegated principal. System agent roles (Agent Observer/Contributor/Operator) are assignable at every tier; custom roles are enterprise-only. Rejected when the role's grants exceed the assigning user's own effective grants (delegation ceiling). Audited with principal_kind='agent'.

agentId.description: Agent public id (agt_…), UUID, or slug — workspace-scoped

roleName.description: IAM role name to attach (e.g. 'Agent Contributor' or a custom role name)

assigned.description: True when the role is now attached

alreadyAssigned.description: True when the agent already held an active assignment
